hypothesis: Retain the Round 3 BF16 aggregation frontier and replace three bias-free self-attention F.linear launches with one F.linear using [Wq;Wk;Wv], then split the result in the same q,k,v order.

projection_equivalence.identity: For x, F.linear(x,[Wq;Wk;Wv]) = [xWq^T,xWk^T,xWv^T]. chunk(3,-1) restores q,k,v in exactly the original order. A larger GEMM may round/schedule differently, which is permitted implementation-level floating-point ordering.
projection_equivalence.bias_proof: SanaVideoArchConfig.attention_bias is false and is passed into SanaVideoLinearAttention, so to_q/to_k/to_v all have bias=None; concatenating weights loses no bias term.

weight_lifecycle.load_order: fsdp_load loads the complete checkpoint state at lines 247-260, runs quant post-processing, then calls model.post_load_weights at line 274.
weight_lifecycle.construction: SanaVideo post_load_weights first casts the loaded transformer to BF16, then invokes build_qkv_merge on every one of 20 self-attention blocks. torch.cat therefore captures final loaded BF16 weights on their current device, not meta or initialization values.
weight_lifecycle.device_residency: Pinned run has dit_cpu_offload=false, dit_layerwise_offload=false, and layerwise_offload_components excludes transformer; the transformer and detached merged tensors remain resident on leased GPU for the request.
weight_lifecycle.mutation: No LoRA, quantization, training, optimizer, or later weight mutation is enabled; original q/k/v Parameters remain intact and the merged tensor is a detached read-only inference copy.
weight_lifecycle.off_identity: With SGLANG_SANA_QKV_MERGE unset/0, _qkv_merge is false, build_qkv_merge returns without assigning, _qkv_w stays None, and forward executes the original three to_q/to_k/to_v modules verbatim.

admissibility_argument: This is exact horizontal GEMM fusion. It changes launch layout only: all q/k/v rows, tokens, heads, blocks, CFG branches, DiT calls, and scheduler steps are preserved; downstream norm/ReLU/RoPE/attention/FFN code is identical. It is admissible method-level lossless kernel work.
